instructions:
waypoint tracks work as epics, stories and tasks. An epic has no parent, every story has an epic, every task has a story.

- A parent's status is derived from its open children: move the children, never the parent.
- Dependencies are between siblings only. An item moves to in_progress, review or done only once blockedBy is empty.
- Close an item (update_item with state closed and a closedReason) rather than delete it.
- Say what you did on an item with add_work_log; talk to people about it with add_comment.
- Every tool takes an id as the full id or a prefix of at least 8 characters, such as its shortId.

tools.name: list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: Items matching every filter given, as GET /items. With no filter, every item, open and closed.

state.description: `open` for only what still needs looking at.

parent.description: Only the children of this item.

heldBy.description: Only items held by this name.

tag.description: Only items carrying this tag, by id or value.

queued.description: true: only queued items, in queue order.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: One item, with its derived status, blockedBy and children, as GET /items/{id}.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: Creates an epic, story or task, as POST /items. A story needs an epic as parent, a task a story; an epic has none.

acceptanceCriteria.description: One per criterion, each a text; they are given ids `c1`, `c2`, … in order.

id.description: The criterion's id on its item: `c1`, `c2`, …, kept while it stays.

status.description: Read back as given until the item has children. On a parent it is stored but has no effect while the parent has children, `done` included: a parent reads `done` by itself once every open child does, so there is nothing to sign off. Never changes a child. `in_progress`, `review` or `done` on a parent still reading `backlog` or `ready` is its Start: refused with 409 while its `blockedBy`, its children's blockers included, is not empty.

parent.description: A story for a task, an epic for a story, null only for an epic.

anyOf.description: An item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its `shortId`.

items.description: An item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its `shortId`.

tools.name: update_item
tools.title: Update an item
tools.description: Changes the fields given in `changes`, as PATCH /items/{id}: status, title, body, criteria, parent, dependencies, queued; close it with state closed and a closedReason.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
The criterion's id on its item: `c1`, `c2`, …, kept while it stays.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every criterion, in order, replacing the list. One given as `{id, text}` keeps that id, and its tick, under the text given; one given as a text keeps the id of a criterion that already reads exactly that, else gets a new id. An id the item does not have is refused with 400.

met.description: Every criterion now met, each by its id or its unique text: replaces every tick held, so a tick another writer made since this one read the item is lost. To tick or untick one criterion, use POST or DELETE `/items/{id}/met`. One already ticked keeps who ticked it and when; one newly named is ticked by this write's `claimed-by`, now. Each must be one of the item's `acceptanceCriteria` as this write leaves them, or the write is refused with 400.

status.description: Read back as given until the item has children. On a parent it is stored but has no effect while the parent has children, `done` included: a parent reads `done` by itself once every open child does, so there is nothing to sign off. Never changes a child. `in_progress`, `review` or `done` on a parent still reading `backlog` or `ready` is its Start: refused with 409 while its `blockedBy`, its children's blockers included, is not empty.

state.description: Closing closes everything still open beneath the item, for the same reason; reopening opens only the item, keeping its status. Closing an epic that has children as `completed` is the person's sign-off: refused with 403 from a write that sends `claimed-by`.

closedReason.description: Required with, and only with, `state: closed`.

anyOf.description: An item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its `shortId`.

items.description: An item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its `shortId`.

reviewedBy.description: The worker reviewing the item, as the reviewer's own name; null clears it.

force.description: Move the item to `in_progress`, `review` or `done` though its `blockedBy` is not empty, recorded as the history entry's `overrode`. The person's alone: refused with 403 from a write that sends `claimed-by`, as every worker's does. Changes nothing on its own.

queued.description: `true` queues the item to start on its own, at the back of the queue, or keeps its place if already queued; `false` takes it off. Only an open epic, story or task that reads `backlog` or `ready` can be queued, as this write leaves it: any other is refused with 400, naming why. Recorded in `history` as a change to `queuedAt`.

tags.description: Not accepted: refused with 400 whatever its value. See `WorkItem.tags`.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.title: Delete an item
tools.description: Deletes an item no other item names, as DELETE /items/{id}. Prefer closing it.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: item_history
tools.title: An item's history
tools.description: Every write to the item and beneath it, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/history.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: An item's comments
tools.description: What people and agents said about the item, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/comments.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Comment on an item
tools.description: Adds a comment to the item, as POST /items/{id}/comments.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: list_work_log
tools.title: An item's work log
tools.description: What was done on the item, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/work-log.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: add_work_log
tools.title: Log work on an item
tools.description: Records what was done on the item, with links to what it made, as POST /items/{id}/work-log.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: tick_criterion
tools.title: Tick a criterion
tools.description: Marks one of the item's acceptance criteria met, by its id (c1, c2, …) or its exact text when no other reads the same, as POST /items/{id}/met.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

criterion.description: The criterion's id, as `c2`, or its text when unique.

tools.name: untick_criterion
tools.title: Untick a criterion
tools.description: Marks one of the item's acceptance criteria not met, by its id or its unique text, as DELETE /items/{id}/met.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

criterion.description: The criterion's id, as `c2`, or its text when unique.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: Every tag: its value, colour and description, as GET /tags.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: Adds a tag to the shared list, as POST /tags.

description.description: What the tag is for, shown when hovering its chip.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.title: Update a tag
tools.description: Changes a tag's value, colour or description, as PATCH /tags/{id}.

description.description: What the tag is for, shown when hovering its chip.

tools.name: tag_item
tools.title: Tag an item
tools.description: Puts a tag, by id or value, on the item and everything beneath it, as POST /items/{id}/tags.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: untag_item
tools.title: Untag an item
tools.description: Takes a tag, by id or value, off the item and everything beneath it, as DELETE /items/{id}/tags/{tag}.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

tools.name: get_queue
tools.title: The queue
tools.description: What the queue is running, what waits in it and why, and its running limit, as GET /queue.

tools.name: start_item
tools.title: Start an agent on an item
tools.description: Asks the configured worker-service for an agent on the item, as POST /items/{id}/assignment; refused when none is configured.

id.description: The item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
